thi-ap31:1.1: Bhavā sabbe parikkhīṇā bhavasandhivimocitā / sabbāsavāmano n' atthi ārocema mahāmuni. // //
thi-ap31:2.1: Purimaṃ kammaṃ kusalaṃ yaṃ kiñci sabbam patthitaṃ / paribhogaṃ ayaṃ dinnaṃ tuyh' atthāya mahāmuni. // //
thi-ap31:3.1: Buddhapaccekabuddhānaṃ sāvakānañ ca patthitaṃ / paribhogaṃ ayaṃ dinnaṃ tuyhatthāya mahāmuni. // //
thi-ap31:4.1: Uccānīcam ayaṃ kammaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sādhu patthitaṃ / uccākulāparikammaṃ kat' amhehi mahāmune. // //
thi-ap31:5.1: Ten' eva sukkamūlena coditā kammasampadā / mānussikam anikkantā jāyiṃsu khattiye kule. // //
thi-ap31:6.1: Uppatte 'va kate kamme jātiyā cāpi ekato / pacchime ekato jātā khattiyā kulasambhavā. // //
thi-ap31:7.1: Rūpavatī bhogavatī lābhasakkārapūjitā / antepure mahāvīra devānaṃ viya Nandane. // //
thi-ap31:8.1: Nibbinditvā agāramhā pabbajimhā 'nagāriyaṃ / katipāhaṃ upādāya sabbā patt' amha nibbutiṃ. // //
thi-ap31:9.1: Cīvaraṃ piṇḍapātañ ca paccayaṃ sayanāsanaṃ / upanenti bahuṃ amhe sadā sakkata-pūjitā.
thi-ap31:13.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ Yasavatī pamukhāni khattiyakaññā bhikkhuniyo aṭṭhārasasahassāni bhagavato sammukhā imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
